sahneler.metin: In darkness, an aircraft carrier sliced an American destroyer in two.
The bow sank in less than five minutes, and seventy four men were killed.
The ships were sailing without lights.
The destroyer was ordered to take up a rescue station.
Its officer thought the ship was on the carrier's other side.
It turned across the carrier's bow.
HMAS Melbourne had sunk another destroyer the same way before.
Night formation procedures came under scrutiny.

aciklama:
Frank E. Evans was cut in half by the carrier HMAS Melbourne. The cause: a conning officer misjudging relative position and turning into the carrier's path.

#shorts #engineering #maritime
